findings.claim: The L22 entry labels findings ambiguously: the identifiers F1, F2 and F1 (2nd) are reused under two different commits (cd637480 and 6c1ddfce), so a reader cannot tell which F1 is meant when cross-referencing the review. The whole entry is also one dense paragraph, unlike the bulleted entries before it, which makes the six-finding mapping hard to follow.

evidence: Docs-only change that appends one log entry (L22) to the feature document. It touches no code or specs.
The entry reports six findings (three under cd637480, three under 6c1ddfce), which matches its 'All six resolved' claim.
The only defect found is a readability one: the reused finding IDs and the single dense paragraph.
